newsitem.title: USA: Most U.S. stock index futures trade lower on NAPM.
newsitem.headline: Most U.S. stock index futures trade lower on NAPM.

text.p: U.S. stock index futures were mostly lower due to the sharp rise in the U.S. May National Association of Purchasing Management (NAPM) index.
"NAPM runs counter to expectations that the Fed would leave rates alone in July," one futures trader said.
NAPM rose to 57.1 in May, versus average trade estimates for a decline to 53.9 from April's 54.2. The rise in May NAPM was the highest since November 1994.
The index shattered ideas, which had been developing last week, that the pace of U.S. economic growth was slowing down from the first quarter, traders said.
They said the U.S. stock market was pricing in low U.S. interest rates on expectations of a slower U.S. growth rate in the second quarter.
The yield on the U.S. cash long bond fell below seven percent, keeping U.S. stocks an attractive investment compared to U.S. government securities, traders and analysts said.
Standard & Poor's 500 futures, which had been diverging from U.S. bonds for several days last week, immediately plunged with U.S. bonds after NAPM data were released.
"It was an obvious bad number," one S&P futures trader said.
Floor traders said heavy offers swept through the pit, erasing June S&Ps' slight gain from the opening.
June S&Ps broke below support at 848.50 and hit 846.00 once September T-bonds cracked their support level at 109-15/32, he said. The pivot point is at 845.20, with support at Friday's low of 831.50.
Fair value to the cash index is at 1.70 points, with arbitrage buy programs at a premium of 2.90 points and arbitrage sell programs at 1.00 over.
June Nikkeis were sharply higher on follow-through buying from GLOBEX. June's last trading day is Thursday, June 12.
Kurt Schultz, a floor analyst at Refco Inc, attributed opening gains to the rebound in the technology sector.
"You are bound to get buyers after the way Intel got abused on Friday," Schultz said. "If tech stocks continue to grind up, that could really help us."
Resistance for June S&Ps is at the all-time high of 854.70.

At 1036 CDT/1536 GMT, June S&Ps were off 0.90 point at 849.70, KCBT Value Lines were up 2.70 at 758.50, Nikkeis were up 255 at 20,395, Midcap 400s were up 0.55 at 280.20, Russell 2000s were up 2.90 at 383.50, Nasdaq 100s were down 1.50 points to 961.25, and NYSE Composites were up 0.30 at 443.10.
